capture_method: Read rendered public shared-conversation DOM. Copied the JSON substring following PI-Stage3-Main-v0.1 in user-pasted transcripts, bound to preceding Trial ID. Saved UTF-8 without trailing newline; identical texts remain separate independently labeled trials.
raw_format: User-pasted transcript JSON; not an authenticated API response export or original wire bytes.
authority_source: The posted Authoritative state and Evidence interpretation sections of the original trial prompts, treated as fixed external evaluation fixtures. Later assistant summaries are not evidence authority.
adapter_policy: omega is the two declared initial candidates for these fixed fixtures; candidate cardinality maps to unresolved/resolved/exhausted; external map_version labels this fixture rather than claiming a source-provided version. selected_response B is retained where explicitly posted; PI-04 remains null.
reference_hash: H1 is an opaque fixture reference from the prompts; internal store integrity uses a separate SHA-256. New committed states receive a computed SHA-256.

excluded.status: CONFOUNDED / NOT SCORED; summary only, raw not recovered
CONFOUNDED / NOT SCORED; summary only, raw not recovered

duplicate_handling: PI-01-T1 is pasted twice in the source, counted once. No proposals were regenerated by a model.
limits: Original API request/response IDs, timing, and byte-level API payloads are unavailable.
PI-05 original trials used fresh-session restart simulation, not actual process restart.
This small adversarial probe is not an incidence study and gives no general prompt-injection failure rate.
